Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the 1998 Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach champion as Juan Pablo Montoya based on unclear search results and proceeded to assume his other sport was tennis without verification. This failure to confirm with reliable sources led the plan toward the wrong person and sport, instead of correctly identifying Alex Zanardi and his practice of handcycling.
